performance.verdict: Zero paid activity makes August's prove-it month unreachable on ads alone.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — $0 Meta, $0 Google — makes CPL analysis impossible and the August prove-it scoreboard inoperable.
Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) still open: 66 GBP calls in 28 days cannot be tied to paid or organic source without it.
Sync items + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) still open: 95 GHL opportunities created with $0 value and 0 appointments booked signals intake pipeline is not reconciled.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for the last 3 days (Aug 25–27), down from a 28-day total of 210; prior 3-day avg was ~2.3 — a confirmed 3-day signal, not noise.
Search Console clicks held at 2–3/day over the last 3 days vs a spike to 8 on Aug 24 — SC gain of 76.92% is real but concentrated, not sustained traction.

suggestions.text: Escalate phone-match attribution gap immediately — 66 unattributed GBP calls in 28 days are invisible on the client's scoreboard.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) remains open. 66 GBP calls logged in the last 28 days cannot be attributed to any paid or organic source without this fix, directly breaking the client's lead-to-patient scoreboard. Success check: every inbound call is matched to a channel source in GHL by 2026-09-01. Sohib to confirm with Ahmed/Ali that the fix is deployed and validated against at least one test call.

suggestions.text: Complete GHL contact cleanup — 95 opportunities at $0 value and 0 appointments is a pipeline integrity failure, not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: The sync items and contact cleanup milestone (due 2026-08-14) is unresolved. 95 GHL opportunities exist with $0 pipeline value and 0 appointments recorded, meaning the client's scoreboard shows no conversion path even if leads are arriving. Success check: all open opportunities have a value, stage, and at least one associated appointment or disposition by 2026-09-01. Nacer to confirm completion and share a before/after contact count with Sohib.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions daily — 3-day zero streak on Aug 25–27 after 210 actions in 28 days; re-check Sep 1 for recovery or structural drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero for three consecutive days (Aug 25–27) after averaging roughly 7.5 actions/day over the prior 28-day window totaling 210. This is a confirmed 3-day signal and may indicate a listing issue, a ranking drop, or a data-reporting lag. No action is taken this cycle. Re-check on 2026-09-01: if GBP actions remain at or near zero, escalate to a listing audit and cross-reference with the SC clicks trend for confirmation.
